propositions: rebar-janitor's Discovery phase should consult `rebar metrics --since/--until --output json` to cite code-health trend evidence (module-size distribution, oversized-module count, churn, refactor-to-addition ratio, cap-change events) alongside one-shot tools.
rebar metrics command surface and registered code-health-lens metric values are not discoverable to agents/contributors because they are not referenced in project documentation.
the `rebar.metrics` registry subsystem (MetricSpec, REGISTRY, is_authoritative) must be documented as a reusable surface for library consumers.
metrics in `unavailable` state (no signal accrued yet) must be handled gracefully in discovery guidance so absence is not treated as zero.
project documentation (user-guide.md, AGENTS.md, reuse-surface.md, discovery.md) must be updated to reference and explain the metrics surface before it can be effectively used.
